method.differences: paired base minus candidate raw sentinel end-to-end; the identical fixed empty correction cancels
method.bootstrap: session-119 paired median statistic: xorshift seed 101, 1999 resamples, nearest-rank 99% interval
method.gain: whole 99% interval above zero and paired median greater than the absolute new A/A statistic
method.regression: whole 99% interval below zero and absolute paired median greater than max(new A/A magnitude, 0.5% of corrected base median)
method.noGc: record only; verdicts use forced GC
method.slopes: ordinary least squares through 5, 10, 20 and 40; fixed kind_0 to kind_4 to kind_0 axis
